mentions.name: Classicalbot
mentions.description: A fully automated database of classical music concerts where crawlers for classical music websites are built and validated by AI. A list of concert-listing URLs is sent to a coding agent to generate each crawler, which is then validated and run on infrastructure for free. Classical music is cited as an ideal use case because sites are crawler-friendly and concert counts per website are small.
mentions.source_excerpt: Classical music concerts database. The interesting part maybe isn't what it is, but how it's done: I'm aiming for a fully automated database, where "crawlers" for the classical music websites are created and validated by AI.
mentions.author: druskacik
